test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘MARKET’ is written as ‘DJNOWB’. How will ‘DETAIL’ be written in that language?
solution:
The table of alphabet place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

'MARKET' is written as 'DJNOWB'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6189dbdd258c9cc36ae7dbe218ac65307db52a548c8678bb803773c0cd9ee107.png] 

Similarly,

'DETAIL' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bace346a37dfcfdd104aa5c54a9fa2b4f53fce7d60b38b4707521afa86700b51.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"HADQOF".**
